description.title: מציאת רכוש
description.summary: This table details the process for handling stolen property that is recovered, either before or after insurance benefits are paid. It outlines the conditions under which the insurer retains ownership or the insured can reclaim the property by returning the funds.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת אדירה כסף מתייחסת למקרה של מציאת רכוש גנוב. אם הרכוש נמצא לפני תשלום הפיצויים, הוא יוחזר למבוטח, אלא אם כן הרכוש ניזוק. אם הרכוש נמצא לאחר תשלום הפיצויים, המבטח יודיע למבוטח, והרכוש יעבור לבעלות המבטח אלא אם המבוטח מודיע בתוך 30 יום שהוא מעוניין לקבל את הרכוש בחזרה תמורת החזרת הפיצויים.

sketch:
42. Property Found
42.1 If property which was stolen is found prior to payment of insurance benefits under this Policy, the property will be returned to the Insured, and the insurer shall not pay insurance benefits unless the returned property was damaged.
42.2 If property that was stolen is found after insurance benefits are paid, the insurer shall inform the insured or vice versa. The property found will transfer to the ownership of the insurer unless the insured notifies the insurer - within 30 days after notification by the insurer or insured as the case may be - that he wishes to receive the property found, in exchange for returning the insurance benefits to the insurer during the said period.

טבלה: מציאת רכוש
This table details the process for handling stolen property that is recovered, either before or after insurance benefits are paid. It outlines the conditions under which the insurer retains ownership or the insured can reclaim the property by returning the funds.
ממדים: Scenario regarding found stolen property, Procedures and ownership transfer

42. Property Found
42.1 If property which was stolen is found prior to payment of insurance benefits under this Policy, the property will be returned to the Insured, and the insurer shall not pay insurance benefits unless the returned property was damaged.
42.2 If property that was stolen is found after insurance benefits are paid, the insurer shall inform the insured or vice versa. The property found will transfer to the ownership of the insurer unless the insured notifies the insurer - within 30 days after notification by the insurer or insured as the case may be - that he wishes to receive the property found, in exchange for returning the insurance benefits to the insurer during the said period.
